settings.question_1: What materials are used in Pearl Mission jewelry?
settings.answer_1: Our jewelry is crafted using genuine freshwater and baroque pearls, set in sterling silver (.925) or 18K gold vermeil—a thick layer of 18K gold over a sterling silver base. Each piece is thoughtfully designed for natural beauty and lasting quality.
settings.question_2: How much is shipping and how long will it take?
settings.answer_2: Shipping is complimentary on all U.S. orders. For international orders over $49, shipping is free; orders under $49 incur a flat fee of $4.99. International deliveries typically arrive within 5–12 business days. Expedited options are available at checkout.
settings.question_3: Will my jewelry look exactly like the photos?
settings.answer_3: Due to the natural formation of pearls, subtle variations in shape, size, texture, and luster are expected between individual pieces. These differences are part of the unique character of natural pearls and are not considered defects—they are a hallmark of authenticity.
settings.answer_4: Yes. All orders are shipped in Pearl Mission's signature packaging, making them beautifully gift-ready right from delivery.

settings.question_1: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer_1: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, and any other payment options displayed at checkout.
settings.answer_2: Absolutely. All transactions are processed through Shopify's secure checkout with SSL encryption, ensuring your payment and personal information is fully protected.
settings.question_3: Can I use a discount code?
settings.answer_3: Yes. Enter your discount code in the order summary at checkout. Only one code may be applied per order.
settings.answer_4: All prices are displayed in USD. Currency conversion may apply based on your location and selected payment method.

settings.question_1: How do I track my order?
settings.answer_1: After your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with a tracking number and link to monitor your delivery in real time.
settings.question_2: Can I cancel or modify my order?
settings.answer_2: We begin processing orders quickly after placement. If you need to cancel or modify an order, please contact us as soon as possible via our contact page. We will do our best to assist before the order is dispatched.
settings.answer_3: Unworn items may be returned within 30 days of receipt. Please contact us by email before initiating a return. Items must be returned in their original packaging and in undamaged condition. Duties and taxes are non-refundable.
settings.question_4: How long does it take to process a refund?
settings.answer_4: Once we receive and inspect your returned item, refunds are typically processed within 6–12 business days to your original payment method.

settings.answer_1: Yes. We use only genuine freshwater and baroque pearls—naturally formed and individually selected for their luster, color, and character. Every piece is unique.
settings.question_2: How should I care for my pearl jewelry?
settings.answer_2: Store your jewelry separately to prevent scratching. Keep pieces away from perfumes, cosmetics, cleaning agents, and prolonged exposure to water. After wearing, gently wipe with a soft, dry cloth to preserve the pearl's natural luster.
settings.question_3: Is 18K gold vermeil durable for everyday wear?
settings.answer_3: Yes. Our 18K gold vermeil features a generous gold layer over a sterling silver base and is suitable for regular wear. To extend its lifespan, avoid frequent contact with harsh chemicals, chlorinated water, and abrasive surfaces.
settings.question_4: What makes each Pearl Mission piece unique?
settings.answer_4: Pearls are formed naturally in living organisms, meaning no two are identical. Minor variations in shape, tone, and surface texture are natural hallmarks of authenticity—and what makes each Pearl Mission piece genuinely one of a kind.
